pretest.review_mindset: strong — reject unvalidated code, move secrets to environment, require independent verification
pretest.trust_calibration: strong — avoid using AI for decisions that cannot be independently understood and verified
pretest.decomposition_strategy: give useful context upfront, review in sections against requirements and edge cases
pretest.selection_criteria: compare against requirements, security, maintainability, tests, and simplicity
pretest.risk_awareness: unreviewed code introducing hidden logic, security, or reliability vulnerabilities in production
pretest.instructor_calibration: High security and verification discipline. Push towards complex architecture decomposition, prompt engineering for system contracts, and parallel agent orchestration.
